title: The Cheaper AI Model Is Also The Better One
description:
Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol both cost $5 per million input tokens. On output, Opus 5 is $25 vs Sol's $30 - about 17% cheaper. And Sol needs approved access, while Opus 5 is open to every developer today. #Shorts #ai #aitools
